task_proposal.design: Separate normalization task: original public input/evaluator/fixture bytes retained; public instruction changes only its network-boundary sentence. New Node oracle, immutable runtime images, native policies and explicit limits are sealed.
task_proposal.semantics: Limits are sealed in task/contract.md and each prepared record. Native turn/step definitions differ and are not a shared efficiency metric; no paid launcher is implemented.
task_proposal.outcome_scope: Provider/model routing, task tool execution, trace conversion, artifact transfer and independent verdict; no coding-performance or campaign-parity claim.
task_proposal.setup_network: no-network after separate immutable image preparation
task_proposal.agent_network: allowlist containing only api.openai.com or api.anthropic.com for the selected slot; inspect the actual resolved phase policy
task_proposal.network_limitations: Harbor Docker policy permits resolver DNS/ICMP; this is not complete network isolation or parity with the laboratory gateway.
task_proposal.credential_policy: Only the separately authorized selected provider credential from .env through the harness; names only in plan, no host auth/HOME/repository/socket mounts, no full environment forwarding.

execution_policy_proposal.provider_route: direct standard API; no custom base URL or proxy route in this first proposal
execution_policy_proposal.version_gate: Independently assert exact profile version and immutable image digest before model execution; Harbor skip_install only warns on mismatch.
execution_policy_proposal.reasoning_effort: medium proposed explicitly; verify effective native mapping per adapter before freezing, and stop/revise the plan if unsupported. This does not imply equal inference behavior.
execution_policy_proposal.native_retries: Disable Pi retries and set mini MSWEA_MODEL_RETRY_STOP_AFTER_ATTEMPT=1 in dedicated pilot configuration. Capture and count remaining native HTTP retries; Harbor retry=0 alone does not disable them.
execution_policy_proposal.autoupdates: Disabled; no runtime package installations or mutable installer invocation.
execution_policy_proposal.native_configs: Dedicated frozen non-secret configs with clean per-trial HOME; no host config or account-session reuse.
execution_policy_proposal.record_admission: Data-only accounting bridge implemented and fixture-validated. Require a valid sealed prepared record, exact independently observed runtime, prior settled billing and complete evidence before a separately authorized live attempt. No launcher or automatic authorization is provided.

budget_proposal.admission: Before each slot, reconciled remaining total and provider allocations must each cover USD2. Resolve the previous slot's attributable billing first; unknown/settling cost blocks the next slot.
budget_proposal.stop: Stop on target overrun, exhausted allocation, missing accounting, unexpected model, boundary failure or incomplete evidence. In-flight requests and delayed billing may overshoot targets.
budget_proposal.failures: Started failures/aborts consume spend and stay in the denominator; never overwrite or silently retry.
budget_proposal.extra_attempts: Require a revised plan and separate approval; no automatic reruns, reserves or expansion.
budget_proposal.main_campaigns: Separate refreshed campaign plan and budget; no budget transfer or automatic promotion.

Six actual native CLI fixture lifecycles passed in Docker network none; four real Harbor Trial controls on representative mini image passed1/0/0/0 with common separate verifier. Scopes differ; full native-agent Trial/live API qualification remains unverified.

Six unexecuted records sealed; data-only importer and scoped core validation tested against identity, measurement, evidence, billing and admission failures. Actual provider billing collection/reconciliation remains unverified; unknown billing blocks admission.
Approve exact frozen slots and separate USD12 proposal; resolve authorized credential use and confirm account/model access only within that later authorization.

acceptance.success: Complete valid evidence, reward1 and verified intended model identity/accounting for the slot. Native CLI exit0 or reward1 alone is insufficient.
acceptance.inconclusive: Missing identity, billing, terminal trace or conversion evidence with otherwise successful task; withhold full qualification and stop admission as applicable.
acceptance.failure: Wrong output, mismatch, timeout, infrastructure error or boundary violation; retain original attempt and actual cost.
acceptance.reporting: Separate execution, task verdict, model identity, accounting and boundary statuses. No missing-to-zero coercion, invented success rate, pass@k or campaign result promotion.
